entries.before: A primer on Doctor Doom, compiled by hand from a reader's outline of Comic Book Herald's guide to the best Doom comics. entries.after: Doom's legend is built here in layers: his origin and its retellings, his sieges of the Fantastic Four, and his bids for cosmic power. Doomquest in Iron Man, the Silver Surfer and the Power Cosmic, Secret Wars, Infinity Gauntlet and Infamous Iron Man follow.
